name: Contoso Contact Center Migration
description: Migration from Genesys to D365 Contact Center with AI-powered routing and Copilot Studio bot

context.current_state: Legacy Genesys on-prem contact center with 450 agents, no AI capability, high AHT
context.desired_state: Cloud-native D365 Contact Center with AI routing, Copilot assistance, and real-time analytics
key_challenges: Complex IVR logic to migrate (87 call flows)
Genesys custom reports need Power BI equivalents
Agent desktop change management for 450 agents
constraints: Cannot run parallel systems for more than 6 weeks
All data must remain in US geo

assumptions.text: Contoso has existing Microsoft 365 E3 licenses — Copilot add-ons will be needed
ACS phone numbers can be provisioned for all 450 agent lines
Dataverse environment will be provisioned in US East region

decisions.title: Use Managed Voice Channel over BYOC
decisions.description: Selected Microsoft-managed ACS voice over Bring Your Own Carrier
decisions.rationale: Simpler operations, included in Contact Center license, lower total cost

decisions.title: Copilot Studio for IVR/Bot, not Azure Bot Framework
decisions.description: Use Copilot Studio for all self-service bot and IVR automation
decisions.rationale: Lower development effort, native D365 integration, generative AI built-in

raid_items.title: IVR migration complexity underestimated
raid_items.description: 87 Genesys call flows may contain logic not directly mappable to Copilot Studio topics
raid_items.mitigation: Conduct IVR audit in sprint 1, identify complex flows for custom development

raid_items.title: Regulatory recording not GA in ACS
raid_items.description: 7-year retention requirement may need custom recording solution
raid_items.mitigation: Evaluate Verint and NICE recording adapter for ACS

raid_items.title: Microsoft tenant admin access for ACS provisioning
raid_items.description: Need Global Admin or Communication Administrator role in M365 tenant
raid_items.mitigation: Request elevated access in kick-off week

raid_items.title: Contoso will provide dedicated dev environment
raid_items.description: Assumes client will provision D365 sandbox environment in week 1
